title: Juha Heinanen
html:
Juha Heinanen has been for several years an active user and contributor to SER, OpenSER, and SIP Router projects. Among other things, Juha’s contributions include enum and lcr modules. His company TutPro Inc. participates in development of commercial OpenSIPg SIP platform.

For further details, see https://tutpro.com.
